final: WITH constructor_counts AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY cs.constructorId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM constructor_counts) SELECT cc.constructorId, cc.nationality, cc.record_count, cc.record_count - ac.avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM constructor_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
